treatment_contract.quantum_policy: Every role invocation uses a fresh clean GPT-5.6 Sol / Instant chat and persists its output into the assigned run state.
treatment_contract.resume_policy: Role handoff is durable only; no role may depend on another role's chat transcript.

role_contract.decomposer: Classify as LEAF_EXECUTABLE or TOO_LARGE and create independently verifiable leaves when needed.
role_contract.leaf_worker: Work one READY leaf/quantum and request at most one external experiment before stopping.
role_contract.synthesizer: Produce terminal candidate only after required evidence and independent critique are durable.

treatment_contract.escalation_policy: No frontier escalation in this arm. Intrinsically difficult residuals may be recorded but remain unsolved by stronger tier here.

control_evaluator.note: Control chat owns deterministic result publication/scoring. Worker must not access evaluator-only oracle.
